|strategy=By [mailto:jediknight@decipher.com Justin Pakes, Jedi Knight]<ref name="decipher-strategy">https://web.archive.org/web/20040811123219/http://www.decipher.com/starwars/cardlists/endor/light/small/surprisecounterassault.html</ref>

The Light Side version of the Special Edition card [[Counter Surprise Assault]] is certainly a handy way to kick your Ewok deck into fast deploy!

Often an issue with "weenie decks" is that you take a bit longer to get enough into hand to deploy "safely". This usually translates to having to put more of the weenies in your deck, reducing room for other vital defences. [[Surprise Counter Assault]] will get your fuzzies our quick smart, and what's cheaper than free?

Use this to get your Ewok Tribesmen, Ewok Sentries and Ewok Spearmen onto [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] in large quantities. Equally useful in an Ewok based [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] Booster Draft deck, as lesser quantities available in your Deck can often make them a little harder to find when you need them.

Combo: = the drain is cancelled, the Ewoks get deployed from Reserve Deck for free at a site with 2 Light Side icons, and if you scare the Dark Side characters to the Used Pile, then from the [[Endor: Rebel Landing Site (Forest){{!}}Forest]] Trail you can get them to any exterior [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] site you wish!
|combos=* lotsa Ewok Sentries + [[Surprise Counter Assault]] + [[Endor: Hidden Forest Trail]] = the drain is cancelled, the Ewoks get deployed from Reserve Deck for free at a site with 2 Light Side icons, and if you scare the Dark Side characters to the Used Pile, then from the [[Endor: Rebel Landing Site (Forest){{!}}Forest]] Trail you can get them to any exterior [[Endor (location){{!}}Endor]] site you wish!<ref name="scomp">https://scomp.starwarsccg.org/?s=Surprise%20Counter%20Assault</ref>
